binance_replenishment.interpretation: Potential in-kind XRP demand exists only if an XRP-specific shortfall remains after existing token inventory and recoveries; no XRP allocation or execution quantity is public.

binance_por_context.bitquery_label_claim: Bitquery labels all 17 drained wallets, including five XRPL source accounts, as Binance PoR wallets.
binance_por_context.coindesk_october_1_crosswalk_scope: Binance 14 Ethereum hot wallet appears in the October 1 PoR set; article reports 1.26B USDT and 89,475 ETH among 37 assets.
binance_por_context.coindesk_eth_reserve_assessment: CoinDesk estimates the approximately 204,500 ETH theft could reduce the October 1 100% ETH reserve ratio to approximately 94% before replenishment.
binance_por_context.next_snapshot_date_evidence: SECONDARY_REPORTING; Binance official post says updated PoR will follow remediation but does not specify November 1.

exchange_wallet_balances.source: XRP Insights; XRPL wallet balances with public XRPSCAN labels
exchange_wallet_balances.custody_scope: Includes hot and cold storage and identified non-customer backing; not tradable float or customer liabilities.

derived_comparisons.interpretation: The total exchange decline is close in magnitude to the incident amount, but Binance's own reported net decline is smaller than the transfer. Wallet-set membership, offsets, internal transfers and other exchange flows prevent attribution.
derived_comparisons.coinbase_vs_binance: Coinbase's +1.1M XRP seven-day change does not establish migration from Binance's -173.2M; self-custody, other venues, internal reclassification and untracked wallets remain alternatives.

market_feature_admission.reason: No token-level replenishment allocation, official five-wallet PoR crosswalk, per-wallet daily exchange history or synchronized market panel.
